# Vibrai — Releases

Signed download bundles for **Vibrai**, the AI music-production tool for Ableton Live.

- **Docs & install guide:** https://docs.vibrai.com
- **Home / buy:** https://vibrai.com
- **Latest release:** https://github.com/cssllcio/vibrai-releases/releases/latest

This repository hosts only the **release binaries** (the source tree is private).
Each release attaches signed macOS (`.pkg`), Claude Desktop
(`.mcpb`), and raw CLI bundles, plus `SHA256SUMS` for verification.

## Report a problem

Open an [issue](https://github.com/cssllcio/vibrai-releases/issues) — bug reports
and feature requests are welcome here even though the source is closed.
